It’s a reminder of how rituals like these connect us across time and distance. If you’d like to tell me more about your sister’s ceremony— the design she chose, a special song that was sung, or how it felt to be part of it— I’m here to listen and reflect with you. 💛 *(And if you ever want to " virtually" design a henna pattern together, I’d love to help brainstorm ideas!)*
